LESSON: FINANCIAL SERVICES

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Entrepreneurship
Topic 5.1: Financial Services
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Financial Services, part of Entrepreneurship in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: What are the services offered by different financial institutions in Kenya?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Financial Services together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Learning to learn: learner acquires skills of organising self-learning when searching for information on services offered by

financial institutions in Kenya.

• Self-Efficacy: learner develops effective communication skills when discussing and presenting the types of financial

49

institutions in Kenya.

• Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving: learner develop interpretation and inference skills when identifying financial

services.

Values:
• Responsibility: learner cares for own property and those of others when handling ICT devices while searching for

information on financial services.

• Unity: learner displays team spirit and collaborates with others when discussing and presenting on the types of financial

institutions in Kenya

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Financial Literacy: learner’s financial literacy skills are enhanced when learning about services offered by financial

institutions.

Link to other subjects:

Agriculture and Nutrition: learner enhances knowledge on investment when discussing and presenting the types of financial

institutions.

Suggested Learning Resources

• Newspapers cuttings on case study on financial institutions

• Digital resources such as Smart phones, laptops and desktops.

• ICT tools.
